If we don't get to our Basilisks, we don't stand a chance.||attr=Canderous Ordo, Veela Ordo, and Revan devise a strategy to get their pilots to their Basilisks|src=<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
In [[3954 BBY]], a '''skirmish''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]] between the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans [[Clan Ordo|Ordo]] and [[Clan Jendri|Jendri]]. During the [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|search]] for [[Mandalore's Mask]], Clan Ordo invaded Clan Jendri's territory, and in retaliation some Jendri [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and four of their [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Ground warfare/Legends|attacked]] Ordo's campsite, attempting to keep Clan Ordo away from their Basilisks. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;who joined Clan Ordo with Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Canderous Ordo]] during the search&mdash;created a distraction to cover six of Clan Ordo's pilots long enough so they could reach and mount their [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Droid/Legends|machines]]. Once in the air, Ordo's Basiliks outnumbered the remaining Jendri pilots, and the surviving Jendri [[Troop/Legends|troops]] fled the battlefield.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|We're well inside Clan Jendri's territory. Gotta stay sharp.''"<br />"''Do you think they know we're here?''"<br />"''Hard to say. If they're anywhere near the Twin Spears, the scouts would have seen us by now. But it's a big territory. They could be a hundred kilometers away in any direction.''"<br />"''Maybe we'll get lucky and they'll never know we're here.|Veela Ordo and Revan, musing if Clan Jendri knows that they are in their territory|<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
In [[3954 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the remaining [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans leftover from the [[Mandalorian Wars]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. They later gathered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]] to [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|search]] for the ancient ceremonial artifact known as [[Mandalore's Mask]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Canderous Ordo]] journeyed to Rekkiad to help [[Clan Ordo]], Canderous' clan, in the search for the mask. Each clan chose their own territory on the planet to hunt for the artifact. One night, Revan&mdash;led by a memory of his last visit to Rekkiad with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Malak|Malak]]&mdash;convinced clan [[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Veela Ordo]], Canderous' [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], and her clan to move into [[Clan Jendri]]'s territory in search of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore's]] Mask.<ref name="TOR:R" />

==The skirmish==
[[File:Basilisk.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Both clans made use of Basilisk droids on Rekkiad.]]
Early one morning, just before dawn, Clan Jendri [[Ground warfare/Legends|attacked]] Clan Ordo in retaliation for the invasion of their territory. Jendri's [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], who outnumbered those of Clan Ordo two to one, targeted their campsite while four of their [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] razed the battlefield from above, pinning down the invaders from reaching their Basilisks. Veela Ordo led her clan into battle, while Revan, who had already taken out a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] and soldier, realized Clan Jendri's strategy. He then created a distraction using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to grab the attention of the Jendri pilots and proceeded to attack the nearest [[Unidentified Clan Jendri pilot|one]]. Revan ran underneath the [[Droid/Legends|machine]], [[Force jump/Legends|leaped]] high into the air, and damaged one of the tails stabilizing fins. The pilot flew back around to get a bead on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master, only to have the Jedi jump onto his machine and [[Death/Legends|kill]] him. His diversion allowed Canderous and five other Clan Ordo pilots&mdash;who previously couldn't make it to their machines without getting strafed&mdash;to safely reach their own Basilisk mounts, get their machines into the air, and proceed to attack the remaining Jendri pilots.<ref name="TOR:R" />

Quickly realizing that they were outnumbered, some of the remaining Jendri [[Troop/Legends|troops]] abandoned the battlefield. The rest who chose to stay were slaughtered by Clan Ordo, and the battle ended in a rout for Clan Jendri.<ref name="TOR:R" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You think they'll try another attack?''"<br />"''No.''"<br />"''You sure? I get the feeling they don't like us being in their territory.''"<br />"''They fled the battle. It's our territory now.|Revan questions Canderous Ordo regarding the chance of retaliation from Clan Jendri|<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
Following the skirmish, Clan Ordo claimed the captured territory from Clan Jendri. Later that night, Veela had a [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] pyre built for the thirty warriors&mdash;consisting of one Clan Jendri pilot, one Jendri sniper, and twenty-two Jendri soldiers, as well as six members of Clan Ordo&mdash;granting those who had fallen a warrior's funeral. The pyre burned for [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] as Clan Ordo honored their memories through [[Music/Legends|songs]] and a feast. They grieved for the fallen but also celebrated their victory.<ref name="TOR:R" />

The next [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Revan and the rest of Clan Ordo climbed the [[First Spear]]&mdash;the home of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath the Second]]'s [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]]&mdash;of the [[Twin Spears]], a pair of columns of [[Water/Legends|ice]] several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] tall, with flat plateaus on top. After ascending to the top, Canderous and Revan rediscovered and investigated the tomb, finding Mandalore's Mask inside of Dramath's [[Dramath the Second's sarcophagus|crypt]]. Shortly after finding the mask, they were ambushed by Veela and five Mandalorians, and in the [[Skirmish in Dramath the Second's tomb|ensuring]] [[Lightfight|firefight]], they were forced to kill Veela and the others.<ref name="TOR:R" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish first appeared within [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="TOR:R" />
